items.problem: Agent never ran 'dotnet build' or Validate-UwpMigration.ps1; the session ended (TURN 26) still exploring source/assets, so no build/validate loop ever executed.
items.evidence: session-log.txt contains no 'dotnet build', no 'winapp build', and no Validate-UwpMigration invocation; final turns (L2458-2648) are still 'view'/'glob' of source files and assets.
items.covered_clearly_at: SKILL.md Step 3 'Build, fix what tooling missed' (tight build→fix→launch loop) and Step 4 '🛑 You are NOT done until Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 reports PASS.'
items.why_no_skill_change: The skill already prominently and repeatedly mandates an early build loop and a final validator gate (dedicated 🛑 sections). A capable model on re-run that follows Step 3/4 would build early and hit the collision immediately; making the skill louder about an already-🛑-marked rule would just add noise. The build-breaking root cause is separately fixed as a skill-defect (bootstrap guard), which removes the collision regardless of when the agent first builds.
